maintenance_led.reason: Sells new apparel, cashmere, leather and accessories to consumers and wholesale; first-time product purchases, not repair or servicing.

publicly_funded.reason: Revenue comes from consumers buying luxury clothing through its stores and website, plus department-store wholesale customers.

serial_acquirer.reason: Grows through its own apparel brand, retail stores, e-commerce and wholesale, not through a stream of acquisitions.

mission_critical.reason: Consumers can easily switch to other apparel brands; fashion clothing involves no retraining, qualification or downtime.
